description: Gate A-D edge search ledger for DAX, following the same workflow as JPN/US500/XAUUSD/NASDAQ.

gate_a_2026-09-17.cost_bps_source: DAX empirical p95-p99 bid/ask spread band (p95=2.788, p99=4.871), midpoint per config/us500_edge_search_ledger.json per_asset_empirical_spread_bps_2026-09-14
gate_a_2026-09-17.kill_bar: gross_mean_R >= 0.05 (standard bar, reverted after the NASDAQ 0.02 experiment)

gate_b_2026-09-17.rule: Rank Gate A survivors' cells by net_R_per_mean_hold_bar at cost_bps=3.83, take top-3 finalists per edge. Not a kill gate. Applied to all 13 Gate A survivors.

gate_c_2026-09-17.rule: Exact bid/ask tick replay on Gate B's top-3 finalists + control geometry. Filter to executable_r (meanR) STRICTLY > 0. Winner = argmax(R/occupied_day) among positive finalists. KILL if none positive.

dailyrangecompletionfade_long.note: marginal -- only 1 of 3 finalists positive, essentially breakeven

gate_c_2026-09-17.recurring_bugs_fixed: build_tick_file_catalog() missing entirely on dailyrangecompletionfade_long and trendpullbackcontinuation_long; wrong dict-key schema (start/end instead of start_date/end_date/filename) on signentropycollapse_short. Same recurring per-edge scaffold gaps seen on JPN/US500/NASDAQ, fixed identically each time.

geometry_locks_2026-09-17.note: For every Gate C survivor, the winning finalist's (event_vol_lookback, event_vol_ewm_span, vertical_horizon, pt, sl) was locked into candidate_events.py + model_rows.py constants AND edge.yaml's labeling: block.

results.volatilitycarry_long: 0.983272 coverage -- BELOW the 0.99 minimum, caused a genuine Step09-lineage failure

FAILED_AT_05_training_artifact_verifier.py -- Step04's calibrated threshold sweep found selection_status=no_positive_executable_threshold_region across its entire observed calibrated-probability range (0.32-0.36); best_executable_expectancy_r=-0.0037, so no valid threshold existed for Step05 to verify. Consistent with (though not solely explained by) its 98.33% Task2A coverage shortfall.

gate_d_v3_2026-09-17.method: shared/edges/gate_d_calibration_monotonicity.py -- AUC-ROC/Mann-Whitney U on raw Step03 OOF predictions vs quote_executable_meta_label. PASS requires AUC>0.5 and p<0.05. Confirmed as the standing, sole Gate D methodology 2026-09-17 after a side-by-side empirical comparison against a Cochran-Armitage decile precision-trend test (shared/edges/gate_d_precision_trend_experiment.py, non-gating) on all 8 NASDAQ Step09-survivors showed 8/8 identical verdicts with closely-tracking p-values -- see nasdaq_edge_search_ledger.json and the gate_d_precision_trend_experiment.py module docstring for the full derivation.
